import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        long cap, cost;
        Edge rev;

        public Edge(int _src, int _dst, long _cap, long _cost, Edge _rev) {
            src = _src;
            dst = _dst;
            cap = _cap;
            cost = _cost;
            rev = _rev;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        int size;
        List<List<Edge>> adj;
        long minCost, totalCost;
        long[] supp;
        long[] ptnl;
        long[] dist;
        Edge[] last;

        public MinCostFlow(int _n) {
            size = _n + 2;
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            minCost = 0;
            totalCost = 0;
            supp = new long[size];
            ptnl = new long[size];
            dist = new long[size];
            last = new Edge[size];
        }

        public MinCostFlow(MinCostFlow other) {
            size = other.size;
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                for (Edge e : other.adj.get(i)) {
                    if (e.src == i) {
                        adj.get(i).add(new Edge(i, e.dst, e.cap, e.cost, null));
                        adj.get(e.dst).add(new Edge(e.dst, i, 0, -e.cost, null));
                        adj.get(i).get(adj.get(i).size() - 1).rev = adj.get(e.dst).get(adj.get(e.dst).size() - 1);
                        adj.get(e.dst).get(adj.get(e.dst).size() - 1).rev = adj.get(i).get(adj.get(i).size() - 1);
                    } else {
                        e.rev.rev.src = i;
                    }
                }
            }
            minCost = other.minCost;
            totalCost = other.totalCost;
            System.arraycopy(other.supp, 0, supp, 0, supp.length);
            System.arraycopy(other.ptnl, 0, ptnl, 0, ptnl.length);
            System.arraycopy(other.dist, 0, dist, 0, dist.length);
            System.arraycopy(other.last, 0, last, 0, last.length);
        }

        public void addEdge(int src, int dst, long cap, long cost) {
            if (cap <= 0) return;
            adj.get(src).add(new Edge(src, dst, cap, cost, null));
            adj.get(dst).add(new Edge(dst, src, 0, -cost, null));
            adj.get(src).get(adj.get(src).size() - 1).rev = adj.get(dst).get(adj.get(dst).size() - 1);
            adj.get(dst).get(adj.get(dst).size() - 1).rev = adj.get(src).get(adj.get(src).size() - 1);
        }

        public boolean solve() {
            int src = size - 2;
            int dst = src + 1;
            long flow = 0;
            long suppSum = 0;
            for (int node = 0; node < size; node++) {
                suppSum += supp[node];
                if (supp[node] > 0) {
                    flow += supp[node];
                    addEdge(src, node, supp[node], 0);
                } else if (supp[node] < 0) {
                    addEdge(node, dst, -supp[node], 0);
                }
                supp[node] = 0;
            }
            if (suppSum != 0) return false;
            while (flow > 0) {
                if (!Dijkstra(src, dst)) return false;
                long resid = flow;
                for (int node = dst; node != src; node = last[node].src) resid = Math.min(resid, last[node].cap);
                flow -= resid;
                minCost += ptnl[dst] * resid;
                for (int node = dst; node != src; node = last[node].src) {
                    last[node].cap -= resid;
                    last[node].rev.cap += resid;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        public long optimal() {
            return solve() ? minCost : -1;
        }

        public boolean Dijkstra(int src, int dst) {
            long[] dist = new long[size];
            Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
            dist[src] = 0;
            PriorityQueue<long[]> que = new PriorityQueue<>((a, b) -> Long.compare(a[0], b[0]));
            que.add(new long[]{-dist[src], src});
            while (!que.isEmpty()) {
                long[] ndistNow = que.poll();
                long ndist = -ndistNow[0];
                long now = ndistNow[1];
                if (ndist != dist[now]) continue;
                ptnl[now] += ndist;
                dist[now] = Long.MAX_VALUE;
                for (Edge e : adj.get(now)) {
                    if (dist[e.dst] > ptnl[now] + e.cost) {
                        dist[e.dst] = ptnl[now] + e.cost - ptnl[e.dst];
                        last[e.dst] = e;
                        que.add(new long[]{-dist[e.dst], e.dst});
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[dst] != Long.MAX_VALUE;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(6100);
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int tlim = 105;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int j = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine()) - 1;
            mcf.supp[j] += 1;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                    mcf.addEdge(u, nv, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                    mcf.addEdge(v, nu, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.addEdge(n * t + i, n * (t + 1) + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        int dst = mcf.size - 1;
        mcf.supp[dst] -= k;
        for (int t = 0; t <= tlim; t++) {
            mcf.addEdge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(mcf.optimal());
    }
}
